fields.description: When unticked the scheduled job exits immediately and does nothing.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: GCP project id. Used by both the image-sync job above and Teacher Reporting below.
fields.label: Project ID

fields.description: Fully qualified messages table used by the image-sync job above, as project.dataset.table.
fields.label: Messages Table

fields.description: Fully qualified media table used by the image-sync job above, as project.dataset.table.
fields.label: Messages Media Table

fields.description: Service account key JSON. Needs BigQuery Data Viewer + Job User on the project above. Stored encrypted. Teacher Reporting below reuses this same project_id + credentials_json.
fields.label: Credentials JSON

fields.description: How far back to query. Keep small — the job runs often and BigQuery bills per byte scanned.
fields.label: Lookback Days

fields.description: How far forward from the last media message to look for the submission. Set from measured drift, not instinct.
fields.label: Match Window (minutes)

fields.description: Maximum submissions processed per run.
fields.label: Batch Limit

fields.description: Timezone of inserted_at in BigQuery. DATETIME carries no timezone, so it must be stated here.
fields.label: Source Timezone

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern matched against the Glific flow label.
fields.label: Flow Label Filter

fields.description: Counts from the most recent run, for spotting a rising number of unmatched rows.
fields.label: Last Run Summary

fields.description: Weekly BigQuery -> parquet extract + on-demand PDF report endpoint for Glific. Shares ONLY the Project ID / Credentials JSON above. Does not read or require the 'Enabled' checkbox, lookback_days, batch_limit, flow_label_filter or any other image-sync field above; has its own tables, filters, secret and schedule.
fields.label: Teacher Reporting

fields.description: Independent of the 'Enabled' checkbox at the top of this doctype — that one is for the image-sync job only.
fields.label: Enable Teacher Reporting

fields.description: Shared secret the on-demand endpoint requires as api_key. Generate a long random value (32+ chars); never reuse a secret from another integration.
fields.label: Shared Secret

fields.description: BigQuery dataset id. Combined with Project ID above and each table name below to form project.dataset.table.
fields.label: Dataset ID

fields.description: BigQuery CONTACTS table name only (no project/dataset prefix). Must have columns: id, phone, updated_at, group_labels, raw_fields (JSON containing student_id.value, grade.value, school_id.value).
fields.label: Contacts Table

fields.description: BigQuery messages table name for this report, no project/dataset prefix. Must have contact_phone, flow_name, flow_label, inserted_at.
fields.label: Messages Table (Stats)

fields.description: BigQuery REGEXP_CONTAINS pattern matched against contacts.group_labels.
fields.label: Group Label Regex Pattern

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern for flow_name, e.g. %YourMainFlowName%.
fields.label: Main Flow Name (LIKE pattern)

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern for flow_label identifying a 'watched' event, e.g. %Activity_Access%.
fields.label: Watched Flow Label (LIKE pattern)

fields.description: SQL LIKE pattern for flow_label identifying a 'shared' event, e.g. %Activity_Submission%.
fields.label: Shared Flow Label (LIKE pattern)

fields.description: Absolute filesystem path (same mount throughout) under which 'live/', '.staging/' and missing.jsonl are kept. A path under the site's private/files tree works by default, e.g. /home/frappe/frappe-bench/sites/<site>/private/files/teacher_reporting.
fields.label: Parquet Storage Dir

fields.description: GCS Settings record (bucket_type=Authenticated) whose bucket_name/project_id/credentials_json are used to upload each school's PDF. Reused as-is — no credentials duplicated here.
fields.label: GCS Settings

fields.description: Hard cap on bytes BigQuery is allowed to scan for this query, in GB.
fields.label: Max Query Size (GB)

fields.description: OK, ERROR, or RUNNING while a run is in progress. RUNNING under 10 minutes old also acts as a lock.
fields.label: Last Run Status

fields.description: Rolling tail of the last 50 runs (OK/ERROR + counts). For troubleshooting only.
fields.label: Run Log
